notice.directive: Seek emergency department assessment now. Do not wait for a message reply; call 911 if you cannot travel safely.

event.text: Go to the emergency department now. Black, tarry stools for two days plus feeling lightheaded when you stand can mean active bleeding in your digestive tract and blood loss, which needs blood tests and a camera exam today. Have someone else drive you, or call 911 if you faint, vomit blood, or feel weak or short of breath on the way.
